title: oeceoclades guineensis
intro: Oeceoclades guineensis, commonly known as the Guinea Pleated Orchid, is a species of orchid native to tropical Africa. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Oeceoclades guineensis include antioxidant and anti-histamine effects, which may aid in reducing inflammation and alleviating allergy symptoms. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
